slice: P3 MATERIAL immutable common carrier guard
problem: Previously, dxfMaterial::sameState covered modeled MATERIAL body only. An application-data change combined with a selected projection edit exported successfully while dropping the added typed common group.

contract.admission: Decode immutable captured MATERIAL baseline and compare all DRW_TableEntry common fields against the caller using the existing standardDwgCommonEqual comparator before either unchanged or edited raw replay.
contract.protectedFields: Identity, base name and flags, appData, XDATA, reactors, extension dictionary and unresolved DWG/common state; the existing body-specific comparison still governs modeled edits.
contract.atomicity: Inconsistent common model is refused before publication, preserving caller and destination; restore to baseline and retry on the same facade.
contract.preserved: Existing normal blend/projection edits and original common groups with XDATA remain replayable when their captured and typed representations agree.

normal.note: BLOCK_RECORD observation was strengthened after the shared cohort and revalidated separately 1/1.

validation.focusedControls: 72 common-field edit refusal/sentinel/same-facade retry controls: six common mutation classes × three body modes × four source/output encoding combinations. Twelve locally-authored APPID/application/XDATA source and output readbacks span the same body modes and encodings.
validation.note: Original readback verifies typed application and XDATA contents, including provider-aware source; no separate native renderer or full-document qualification.
validation.sourceChronology: The normal shared cohort included simultaneously prepared TABLE and BLOCK_RECORD work; BLOCK_RECORD was subsequently strengthened and passed separately. The final ASan 9/9 included that strengthened BLOCK_RECORD state. The TABLE and BLOCK_RECORD revisions were committed separately as the hashes listed in sourceBindings.

reviewWitness.sourceNote: Previously independently authored peer source with unrelated EZDXF_META dictionary removed; selected MATERIAL unchanged.
reviewWitness.preFixResult: A selected normal-projection edit plus additional typed application group succeeded, but ordinary source/output readback changed appData group count 2→1. This original diagnostic deliberately checks group-count loss and uses a caller-authored group.
reviewWitness.postFixResult: Unchanged/blend/projection × appData/XDATA/base flags all refuse with sentinel and caller preserved and succeed on corrected retry; corresponding no-fault controls export and read back original reactor group.
reviewWitness.physicalOriginalAndOutput: The independent ezdxf physical loader confirmed the original and projection output common prefixes match, including MATERIAL handle 2F, reactor 330 E and owner E.

limitations: This guard rejects common-carrier changes; it does not implement serialization of typed common metadata edits.
No native consumer/rendering or full-document support claim is made.
